hadith:
Patients - Narrated Anas:

A Jewish boy used to serve the Prophet (ﷺ) and became ill. The Prophet (ﷺ) went to pay him a visit and said to him, "Embrace Islam," and he did embrace Islam. Al-Musaiyab said: When Abu Talib was on his deathbed, the Prophet (ﷺ) visited him.
message: In embracing faith, we find solace and purpose. Just as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) showed compassion towards others regardless of their background, let us extend kindness and understanding to those around us. Remember, Allah is Al Aakhir, the Eternal One who encompasses all beginnings and endings, guiding our journey through life.
name:
Al Aakhir - الآخِرُ - The Last

The name Al Aakhir signifies that Allah is the ultimate end of all existence. In Islamic theology, this name emphasizes His eternal nature and the idea that everything in the universe has a beginning and an end, but Allah remains beyond the constraints of time. It reflects the belief in the Day of Judgment and the finality of His will.
